2610.06636.title: Differentially Private Mixing of Public Datasets Improves Private Learning
2610.06636.paper_summary: Many machine learning applications involve sensitive data and therefore require training under differential privacy (DP). However, DP training often degrades model utility. In some cases, first pre-training the model on "public" data before finetuning with DP on the sensitive data can reduce the drop in utility. However, the success of this depends on how relevant the selected public dataset is to the sensitive data. We introduce the first pipeline that privately learns the mixture of several public datasets to pretrain on for a given sensitive downstream task. Our key insight is that we can privately find the best mixture of multiple public datasets by privately learning a low-dimensional linear model. We tested our method on the NIH dataset for X-ray classification and the ENRON email dataset for language modeling. Applying our method to find tailored mixtures of X-ray datasets to pretrain on for diseases in the NIH ChestX-ray14 dataset, we improved macro AUC by up to 0.037 across privacy budgets compared to the baselines, with gains as large as +22.8% relative AUC on Cardiomegaly at $ε=1$. For DP training on the ENRON dataset, pre-training on our mixture of The Common Pile (a collection of public-domain text datasets) decreased test perplexity by 16% relative to the baseline mixtures.
2610.06636.paper_summary_zh: 許多機器學習應用涉及敏感數據，因此需要在差分隱私（DP）下進行訓練。 然而，DP訓練往往會降低模型的效用。 在某些情況下，先在“公共”數據上對模型進行預訓練，然後再在敏感數據上進行DP微調，可以減少效用的下降。 然而，這一成功取決於所選公共數據集與敏感數據的相關性。 我們介紹了第一個管道，私下學習幾個公共數據集的混合，以便在給定的敏感下游任務上進行預訓練。 我們的關鍵見解是，我們可以通過私下學習一個低維線性模型，私下找到多個公共數據集的最佳混合。 我們在NIH數據集上進行了X光分類測試，並在ENRON電子郵件數據集上進行了語言建模。 將我們的方法應用於尋找量身定制的X光數據集混合，以便在NIH ChestX-ray14數據集上進行預訓練，我們在隱私預算下將宏觀AUC提高了最多0.037，與基準相比，在心臟肥大（Cardiomegaly）上相對AUC的增益高達+22.8%（在$ε=1$時）。 對於ENRON數據集的DP訓練，在我們的公共文本數據集集合The Common Pile的混合上進行預訓練，相對於基準混合，測試困惑度降低了16%。
